overrides.name: Anti-AI-Flavor
overrides.description: Adds configurable narrative style constraints for English and Chinese sessions.
overrides.author: charlesli1989
overrides.notes: Source: ackness/covel#81. The author agreed to directory inclusion; license and Covel compatibility await confirmation. Not recommended for installation yet. Upstream code has not been copied or relicensed.

zh-CN.name: Anti-AI-Flavor / 去 AI 味
zh-CN.description: 按中英文会话语言注入可配置的叙事文风约束。
zh-CN.notes: 来源：ackness/covel#81。作者已同意目录收录；许可证和适配版本待作者确认，暂不列为可安装推荐。未复制或重新许可上游代码。

overrides.name: DashScope Images
overrides.description: A two-stage workflow combining LLM prompts, Wan image generation, and a persistent gallery.
overrides.author: covel-ai
overrides.notes: Official optional plugin moved from the Covel main repository. Restart and grant session code approval after installation. Requires a configured model role. Only one illustration flow (DashScope or OpenAI Images) can be active in a session.

zh-CN.name: DashScope 剧情生图
zh-CN.description: LLM 提示词、万相图像生成与持久化画廊的两段式流水线。
zh-CN.notes: 从 Covel 主仓迁移的官方可选插件；安装后重启并在会话中授权。需要配置对应模型用途。同一会话只能启用一个插图流程（DashScope 或 OpenAI 图片二选一）。

overrides.name: Jev Choice Recommendations Demo
overrides.description: An advanced example combining typed inputs, evaluation models, public services, and a stage probability UI.
overrides.author: covel-ai
overrides.notes: Official optional plugin moved from the Covel main repository. Restart and grant session code approval after installation. Requires a configured model role.

zh-CN.name: Jev 选项推荐 Demo
zh-CN.description: 复杂开发示例：类型化输入、evaluation 模型、公共服务与舞台概率 UI。
zh-CN.notes: 从 Covel 主仓迁移的官方可选插件；安装后重启并在会话中授权。需要配置对应模型用途。

overrides.name: MiMo Narration
overrides.description: Automatic and manual narration with a custom speech wire, background jobs, and an audio panel.
overrides.author: covel-ai
overrides.notes: Official optional plugin moved from the Covel main repository. Restart and grant session code approval after installation. Requires a configured model role.

zh-CN.name: MiMo 旁白朗读
zh-CN.description: 自动或手动朗读剧情，演示自定义 speech wire、后台任务与音轨面板。
zh-CN.notes: 从 Covel 主仓迁移的官方可选插件；安装后重启并在会话中授权。需要配置对应模型用途。

overrides.name: Clean Note Example
overrides.description: Entry-only note formatter that trims line whitespace and excess blank lines while preserving paragraphs.
overrides.author: covel-ai
overrides.notes: Official composable-notes example. Provides the examples.note-format@1 service; version 2.0.0 requires Notes Workbench 2.0.0 or later. Install independently and approve server code per session.

zh-CN.name: 笔记清理示例
zh-CN.description: 纯 entry 格式化服务：清理行首行尾空白与多余空行，保留段落。
zh-CN.notes: 官方组合记录示例，提供 examples.note-format@1 服务；2.0.0 须与记录工作台 2.0.0 及以上配合。须单独安装并在会话中授权服务端代码。

overrides.name: Outline Note Example
overrides.description: Entry-only note formatter that turns nonblank lines into a plain-text bullet list.
overrides.author: covel-ai
overrides.notes: Official composable-notes example. Provides the examples.note-format@1 service; version 2.0.0 requires Notes Workbench 2.0.0 or later. Install independently and approve server code per session.

zh-CN.name: 笔记大纲示例
zh-CN.description: 纯 entry 格式化服务：将非空行整理成纯文本项目符号列表。
zh-CN.notes: 官方组合记录示例，提供 examples.note-format@1 服务；2.0.0 须与记录工作台 2.0.0 及以上配合。须单独安装并在会话中授权服务端代码。

overrides.name: Notes Workbench Example
overrides.description: A notes panel that discovers independent formatter services and saves results after successful processing.
overrides.author: covel-ai
overrides.notes: Official composable-notes example: manual runtimes, services and an HTML panel. Works alone for raw notes; formatters need version 2.0.0 or later.

zh-CN.name: 记录工作台示例
zh-CN.description: 记录面板发现独立格式化服务，处理成功后保存结果。
zh-CN.notes: 官方组合记录示例：手动 runtime、服务与 HTML 面板。可单独安装用于原样保存；格式化插件须为 2.0.0 及以上。

overrides.name: OpenAI Images
overrides.description: Generates story illustrations through the OpenAI-compatible image pipeline and displays a gallery.
overrides.author: covel-ai
overrides.notes: Official optional plugin moved from the Covel main repository. Restart and grant session code approval after installation. Requires a configured model role. Only one illustration flow (DashScope or OpenAI Images) can be active in a session.

zh-CN.name: OpenAI 兼容剧情生图
zh-CN.description: 通过 OpenAI 兼容图像管线生成剧情插图并展示画廊。
zh-CN.notes: 从 Covel 主仓迁移的官方可选插件；安装后重启并在会话中授权。需要配置对应模型用途。同一会话只能启用一个插图流程（DashScope 或 OpenAI 图片二选一）。

overrides.name: Story Note Example
overrides.description: Demonstrates adding a narrative suggestion to story prompts through PostContextAssembly.
overrides.author: covel-ai
overrides.notes: Official authoring example, disabled by default. Requires session code approval after installation. Uses the current public hook contract.

zh-CN.name: Story Note / 叙事便签示例
zh-CN.description: 演示通过 PostContextAssembly 为 story 提示词追加一句叙事建议。
zh-CN.notes: 官方开发示例，默认不启用；安装后仍需会话代码授权。适配当前公共 hook 契约。
